1 范围 Scope
本标准规定了电子电气系统 / 部件的电气、机械、气候、化学及寿命通用技术要求。它作为每个电
气电子系统/部件的具体技术规范或技术要求的基础，为产品的开发，认可及质量检验提供基础试验检
验依据。在使用本标准时，试验按照 4.8.3 章节顺序执行，若有补充说明的需与对应的专业部门进行协商
确定。缺少检测精度说明的，以基本要求为准。
This standard specifies, electrical, mechanical, climatic, chemical and life for electrical and electronic
systems/components. It serves as the basis for each electrical and electronic systems/components’ specific
technical specifications or technical requirements, provides basic test basis for product development, approval
and quality inspection. When using this standard, tests are performed in sequence of chapter 4.8.3. Any
supplementary explanations with this standard that must consult with corresponding professional department. If
lack of detection accuracy description, then subject to basic requirements.
本标准适用于汽车电气和电子零部件（包括以下电压等级的电子零部件）
This standard applies to automotive electrical and electronic components （ Includes electronic components
of the following voltage levels ） .
电压等级 A voltage class A
电子元器件或电路的最大工作电压值范围在交流电压有效值 30V 以内，或者直流电压 60V 以内。
Classification of an electric component or circuit with a maximum working voltage (3.11) of ≤ 30 V a.c.
(RMS) or ≤ 60 V d.c. respectively.
电压等级 B voltage class B
电子元器件或电路的最大工作电压值范围在交流电压有效值（ 30V-1000V ）以内，或者直流电压
（ 60V-1500V ）以内。
Classification of an electric component or circuit with a maximum working voltage (3.11) of (> 30 and ≤
1 000) V a.c. (RMS) or (> 60 and ≤ 1 500) V d.c. respectively.
备注：电压等级 A 适用于 12V 系统或带 12V 系统控制的高压零部件。
Note: Voltage class A applies to the voltage of 12V system or the high voltage components with 12V system control.

5.3.7.1 试验目的 Test aim
这是一个加速试验，模拟车辆中大量的慢温度循环，与实际车辆中大量的慢速温度循环应力变化，

试验方法参考标准 ISO 16750-4-2023 中的 5.5.2.4 执行。
The test method shall be carried out in accordance with 5.5.2.4 of the standard ISO 16750-4-2023.
将样品按照实车安装方式，放置在试验箱中，一个循环是 7 天，一个循环包括在（ 35 ± 2) ℃条件下，
连续喷雾 2h ，然后在（ 40 ± 2) ℃、相对湿度（ 93 ± 3 ） % 的湿热条件下存放 22h ，重复四次后，把样品
存放在（ 23 ± 2) ℃、相对湿度（ 50 ± 5 ） % 的标准大气条件下 3 天。循环次数根据严酷程度选择 2 、 4 个
The samples were placed in the test chamber according to the way of real vehicle installation. One cycle
lasted for 7 days. One cycle included continuous spray for 2h at (35 ± 2) ℃ , and then storage for 22h at (40 ± 2) ℃
and relative humidity (93 ± 3) %. The samples were stored under standard atmospheric conditions of (23 ± 2) ℃
and relative humidity (50 ± 5) % for 3 days. Cycle number Choose 2 or 4 cycles according to the severity. 注：
试验过程中工作模式 1.2 ，对于具有开放式外壳的旋转部件，可以在标准大气下短时间内分别运行工作
模式 3.3 或 4.3 ，以避免活动部件被腐蚀堵塞。激活次数和激活持续时间应由吉利工程师和供应商商定，
运行时间尽量短。
Note: During the test, the working mode is 1.2. For rotating parts with open shells, the working modes 3.3
or 4.3 can be operated separately under standard atmosphere for a short period of time to avoid corrosion and
blockage of moving parts. The number of activations and the duration of activations should be agreed upon
between Geely engineers and suppliers, and the running time should be as short as possible.
试验后应在流动的自来水中清洗 5min ，再用蒸馏水或去离子水漂洗，用手摇晃或者用气流吹去水
珠，然后在温度（ 55 ＋ 2 ）℃的条件下干燥 1h ，接着室温下恢复（ 1 ～ 2 ） h 。
After the test, it shall be washed in running tap water for 5min, rinsed with distilled water or deionized
water, shaken by hand or blown with air flow to remove the water beads, dried at （ 55 + 2 ）℃ for 1h, and
then recovered at room temperature for （ 1 ~ 2 ） H.

a warm basement from cold air; Or when the car window is opened, humid and hot air may flow into the cold
or dry indoor area of the air conditioner, which may cause condensation; The common failure mode is due to
moisture, which can cause leakage current and corrosion between the terminals of the PCB or external
connector, leading to the failure of electrical components; It is also possible that condensation may occur due
to changes in environmental temperature, and long-term exposure to humid air can cause similar internal
corrosion (such as electrochemical migration on the surface of PCBs or components) due to the accumulation

5.3.13.3 试验方法 Test methods
试验方法参考ISO 16750-4-2023中的5.8.2执行。
The test method shall be carried out in accordance with 5.8.2 of ISO 16750-4-2023.
依据表55进行选择试验条件，在第一个循环开始前，先检查样品是否有冷凝，根据表55参数进
行测试，试验循环A如图46所示，试验循环B如图47所示；
According to Table 55, select the test conditions. Before the start of the first cycle, check whether the
sample has condensation. Test according to the parameters in Table 55. Test cycle A is shown in Figure 46,
and test cycle B is shown in Figure 47;
在高温高湿阶段，需要监控样品表面温度，若未达到设定值，可以延长高温高湿阶段的时间，达
到样品表面冷凝；在下一个循环开始前，若样品表面未干燥，应延长高温高湿阶段（A型）或除湿阶
In the high temperature and high humidity stage, it is necessary to monitor the surface temperature of the
sample. If the set value is not reached, the time of the high temperature and high humidity stage can be
extended to achieve surface condensation of the sample; Before the start of the next cycle, if the sample
surface is not dry, the high-temperature and high humidity stage (Type A) or dehumidification stage (Type B)
should be extended.
在每个循环的低温阶段开始前，需保证样品达到指定温度；
Before starting the low-temperature stage of each cycle, it is necessary to ensure that the sample reaches
the specified temperature;
每个循环需要进行两次功能测试，环境温度达到最大温度（小型或轻型样品）或环境湿度达到最
大湿度（大型或重型样品）时，最短时间内用工作模式3.3进行第一次功能测试；在高温高湿阶段结
束前用工作模式3.3进行第二次功能测试；
Each cycle requires two functional tests. When the ambient temperature reaches the maximum
temperature (for small or light samples) or the ambient humidity reaches the maximum humidity (for large or
heavy samples), the first functional test should be conducted in working mode 3.3 as soon as possible; Conduct
a second functional test using operating mode 3.3 before the end of the high temperature and high humidity
stage;
高温高湿阶段，样品周围风速为(1±0.5)m/s。
During the high temperature and humidity stage, the wind speed around the sample is (1 ± 0.5) m/s.
注：该测试期间需持续监控（例如静态电流、工作电流） ，监控曲线及要求需在报告中体现。监控时间和频率等由
吉利试验工程师和相关部门达成一致意见为准。
Note: Continuous monitoring (such as static current and working current) is required during this testing period, and the
monitoring curve and requirements should be reflected in the report. The monitoring time and frequency shall be agreed upon by
Geely's testing engineers and relevant departments.

5.3.14.1 试验目的 Test aim
模拟样品的间歇性工作造成外壳内部温度变化从而吸入灰尘，常见的失效模式是灰尘的进入消弱
机械系统的功能，及灰尘堆积造成的功能故障，例如触点表面灰尘堆积造成接触不良。
Intermittent operation of the simulated sample causes temperature changes inside the casing, leading to
the inhalation of dust. Common failure modes are the entry of dust into the weakened mechanical system, as
well as functional failures caused by dust accumulation, such as poor contact caused by dust accumulation on
the contact surface.

5.3.16.1 试验目的 Test aim
模拟样件用于有腐蚀性气体的环境中，例如，在高度污染的空气中，失效模式为电气触点表面由绝
缘腐蚀物导致的电气故障，与连接触点及开关有关，另一失效模式为因保护涂层（如油漆）被渗透导致
其下层结构遭到腐蚀。适用于外部件，对室内件不做要求。
The simulation sample is used in the environment with corrosive gas. For example, in the highly polluted
air, the failure mode is the electrical failure caused by insulating corrosion on the surface of the electrical contact,
which is related to the connecting contact and the switch. The other failure mode is the corrosion of the
underlying structure due to the penetration of the protective coating (such as paint). It is applicable to external
components and does not require indoor components.

2.4 Monitoring Concept
The NOx signal, O2 and Status Byte will be monitored with a NOx Checkbox via the CAN bus.
When the NOx Checkbox detects a signal out of specification/error condition it generates an error
signal which is monitored with the mask function of an oscilloscope and can be fed back to the test
system.
In order to obtain a reliable data transmission outside of the RF chamber and to protect the
Checkbox, unless otherwise stated optical CAN transceivers are used. The NOx Checkbox has an
internal CAN termination of 120Ω, thus care should be taken to provide the other termination resistor
for the bus, in case the DUT does not assemble it, so the results are the standard 60Ω.
In the Oscilloscope (3) different Channels shall be set up:
1. Voltage Supply in Ubatt (Pin 1): Signal to be measured as close as possible to the DUT.
2. DUT’s Current Consumption (Pin 1): Signal to be measured with a Current Clamp.
3. Error Output: signal generated from NOx Checkbox
After switching on the NOx electronics, the sensor heats up. During this phase the Checkbox’s
error output is at low level (0 V). After the heat up phase (up to 5 min) the error output stays stable at
high level (5V). At this point the DUT is in FSC A and the test can start.

upcoming emission legislations such as Euro IV, V, VI, VII and US2007. The sensor helps to control

The purpose of this document is to describe the DV/PV electrical qualification program that must be
successfully completed in order for Vitesco and the customer to consider the assembly qualified for use
in the end application for which it was designed. This specification was developed in accordance with
the customer electrical test specifications and international standardization.
1.1 Short description of the DUT
The Vitesco / NGK Smart NOx-Sensor is a stand-alone, multifunctional sensor, which measures both
the NOx-concentration and the air/fuel-ratio lambda in the exhaust gas. In order to comply with the
upcoming emission legislations such as Euro IV, V, VI, VII and US2007. The sensor helps to control
different kind of exhaust gas after treatment both at gasoline and diesel engines, e.g.:
- Regeneration of NOx storage catalyst at lean burn gasoline and diesel engines
- On-board-diagnosis and closed-loop control of Selective-Catalytic-Reduction (SCR)
applications at Light and Heavy-Duty Trucks.

The purpose of this document is to describe the DV/PV electrical qualification program that must be
successfully completed in order for Vitesco and the customer to consider the assembly qualified for use
in the end application for which it was designed. This specification was developed in accordance with
the customer electrical test specifications and international standardization.
1.1 Short description of the DUT
The Vitesco / NGK Smart NOx-Sensor is a stand-alone, multifunctional sensor, which measures both
the NOx-concentration and the air/fuel-ratio lambda in the exhaust gas. In order to comply with the
upcoming emission legislations such as Euro IV, V, VI, VII and US2007. The sensor helps to control
different kind of exhaust gas after treatment both at gasoline and diesel engines, e.g.:
- Regeneration of NOx storage catalyst at lean burn gasoline and diesel engines
- On-board-diagnosis and closed-loop control of Selective-Catalytic-Reduction (SCR)
applications at Light and Heavy-Duty Trucks.
